##### Project general facts

Cubix Residences is an elegantly designed L-shaped residential development by Qube Development, created to bring trailblazing building solutions and truly liveable homes to life. The building offers a wonderfully diverse range of residences, including studio apartments, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, as well as two-bedroom and three-bedroom duplexes and penthouses. Every home has been creatively engineered to elicit the utmost in alluring style, comfort and quality of living, exceeding everyday expectations at every turn.

Residents of Cubix Residences enjoy an impressive array of amenities designed around health, happiness and convenience. A beautiful community swimming pool, indoor gym, jogging track, and dedicated shower rooms encourage an active, health-conscious lifestyle, while the sauna and steam room provide indulgent heat therapy for relaxation and recovery. The development is further elevated by high-tech facilities such as full home automation, AI-optimised car and facial recognition systems, integrated security cameras, efficient purpose-built lifts, electric vehicle charging, solar energy systems, and a dedicated Innovation Hub workspace, all backed by attentive 24/7 security.

Inside, Cubix Residences embraces spacious, integrated interiors that place family living and everyday comfort at the heart of every design choice. Living rooms, dining areas and bedrooms are finished with a sophisticated palette of natural materials, elegant lighting and premium furnishings that create a warm, contemporary atmosphere throughout. Master bathrooms feature sleek fittings and quality finishes, while select duplexes and penthouses are complemented by private swimming pools, delivering a truly premium and unleashed lifestyle experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike. This idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood is designed to offer a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Residents of JVC enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It's a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.
